nom: Avène Hydrance+ Moisturizing Sunscreen Lotion SPF 30

segments.dry: One reviewer with sensitive, dry, rosacea skin reports it works well for her, with a nice finish and no irritation at all.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin reports it feels really greasy and slimy despite being labeled oil-free and won't repurchase; another with normal, sometimes normal-oily combination skin says it is not her favorite and that makeup slides off after about 30 minutes.
segments.sensitive: Reports from reviewers with sensitive skin are split: most, including several with rosacea, report no irritation at all and call it uniquely gentle compared to other sunscreens that usually dry out or irritate their skin; however, one reviewer with sensitive skin reports her skin began burning painfully on application and stayed sore for a long time afterward, even after washing it off.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal, sometimes normal-oily combination skin reports it is not her favorite, with makeup sliding off after about 30 minutes, and speculates it might work better on very dry skin instead.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the sunscreen as moisturizing and hydrating, giving skin a dewy, glowy look; no reviewer in this set reports a drying effect.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports her skin began burning on application and stayed sore for a long time even after washing it off; by contrast, several other reviewers, including some with rosacea, report zero irritation.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer who normally breaks out from any sunscreen reports this is the first one that hasn't clogged her pores or caused irritation, calling it a good moisturizer replacement.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with combination skin reports the sunscreen itself feels greasy and slimy on her skin despite being labeled oil-free.

aspects.libelle: Can pill rather than absorb into skin
White cast needs rubbing in or time to fade
Lingering or off smell for some users
Pump packaging wastes product, hard to open
Lightweight, easy to spread for most
Feels thick or sticky to a couple of users
SPF 30 considered too low for summer by one user

extraits.texte: I have sensitive skin. I really love this brand and enjoy using other products. I bought this cream back in February. But the need to apply sun protection has only now arisen. I applied the cream and my skin simply began to burn. Such terrible discomfort. I waited about 20 minutes, I thought that this burning sensation would go away. But no(I had to urgently wash off this cream. My skin hurt for a long time. It's a shame(

I really wanted to love this product because it is clean and highly rated on Yuka. However, it doesnt sink into the skin and I ended up with little white pilling all over my face. I tried using after thoroughly hydrsting my skin and still the same issue. Would not recommend
Oil-free but feels slimy and has a weird smell. I have combo skin so it feels really greasy. Glad I got it on sale and won't repurchase.

Might work on super dry skin, but not for my normal (sometimes normal/oily combo) skin. Makeup is sliding off after 30 minutes. Glad I purchased while on sale because not worth the full price. Will keep to use on hands and neck since it does not smell and still need sunscreen protection.

I use mostly Avene products. I've also tried many mineral sunscreens, most dry out my sensitive rosacea skin. This sunscreen is moisturizing, easy to spread, very minimal (if any) white cast and doesn't contain any unnecessary ingredients that would cause irritation to the skin. It's a great everyday sunscreen to wear under makeup in the spring, fall and winter. I'd prefer a higher spf for summer time. Overall excellent and will repurchase.

I tend to break out after using sunscreen, no matter the brand. This is the first face sunscreen that didn't clog my pores or cause irritation! It's a perfect moisturizer replacement in the morning. A little thick but still feels nice on the skin.
I have sensitive, dry, rosacea skin and this sunscreen/moisturizer works well for me. Nice finish and no irritation at all.

reserve: With only 13 reviews total and close to 40% rating it 3 stars or below, this is a small, sharply divided sample, especially regarding sensitive skin, where reactions range from no irritation to painful burning.
